    Profile

    Elizabeth is the third princess of the Kingdom of Liones, brought here from another world. Although she mainly works as a waitress at the Boar Hat bar, she serves as the bartender in Meliodas's absence. She is a kind young woman, but can show strong spite for those who hurt her friends or those who are unjust. She can be courageous when the time calls for it.
